quarterly_data.signal: Supermicro's 10-Q: remaining non-cancelable purchase commitments for inventory and non-inventory items, primarily through the next 12 months, were $10.1 billion as of March 31, 2026, including $228.6 million for related parties. Transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was approximately $2,135.6 million as of March 31, 2026 (about 69% to be recognized in the next 12 months). Fiscal year 2026 capital expenditures are anticipated at $155.0 million to $175.0 million. Purchases from related-party contract manufacturers Ablecom and Compuware were 2.2% and 2.1% of cost of sales for the three and nine months ended March 31, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: non-cancelable purchase commitments $10.1 billion as of March 31, 2026; RPO ~$2,135.6 million; fiscal 2026 capex $155.0 million-$175.0 million
